messages:
Lina: Idea: quick 40m webinar 'Serving LLMs: Real-world choices that cut cost without killing latency' 
Goal: generate Dedicated trials and Redwood Optimize interest. Proposed date: Tue Aug 2 10:00am PT. Need run-of-show, speakers, rehearsal date, reg form fields.

Evan: I can present operational patterns (10m) + a short checklist teams can copy.

Rishi: I'll demo a two-path routing example: low-latency path vs cost-optimized fallback. Need 18m for demo incl. metrics.

Tess: I'll try to pull a short customer snippet from RetailOps; legal permitting. Also: require reg form to include "Deployment priority" (Latency / Cost / Security) and typical company size for routing.

CalendarBot: Placeholder event created: "Serving LLMs: Real-world choices" Tue Aug 2 17:00 UTC / 10:00 PT.

Lina: Draft run-of-show: 10:00-10:05 intro + goals (Lina)
10:05-10:15 operational patterns (Evan)
10:15-10:33 routing demo + live metrics (Rishi)
10:33-10:38 customer clip (Tess + RetailOps)
10:38-10:48 panel Q&A (group)
10:48-10:50 CTA & survey (Lina)

Evan: Prefer keep demo >12m but <20m. If customer approved, we can swap lengths: customer 6-8m and demo 14-16m.

Rishi: Rehearsal asks: reserved staging pod, ability to seed cache, a test account with token-scoped metrics, and a recording smoke test. Suggest full dress Aug 1 09:00 PT.

Tess: Promo timeline: 12 days out announce blog + email; 6 days paid social + partners; 2 days reminder. Need bios + headshots by next Wed.

Lina: Marketing asks: add hidden reg fields utm_source and account_owner. Tess, route customer-intent leads to AE group.

CalendarBot: Rehearsal event scheduled: Aug 1 16:00 UTC / 09:00 PT. Attendees: Lina, Evan, Rishi, Tess.

Evan: I'll own the slide deck and TL;DR slide. Rishi, send demo checklist by Friday so infra can reserve pods.

Rishi: Will post checklist in #eng-runtime today and confirm pod reservation.

Lina: Action list recap: Evan = deck; Rishi = demo infra + rehearsal; Tess = customer clearance + reg fields; Lina = landing, email copy, invite cadence.

Tess: :thumbsup: I'll chase legal on RetailOps and share the quote or fall back to a generic anonymized metric if needed.

Lina: Great — please keep updates in this thread. I'll lock the page and start draft promos once bios arrive.
